method: Computed with this app's exact finite-shoe analyzer (dealer peek, hole card modelled). The remaining shoe at true count t is D decks with the running count spread over the Hi-Lo ranks in proportion; the best play is evaluated at integer true counts −10..+10 at ~60% and ~30% of the shoe remaining, and crossings are interpolated. Two-card hands only; splits without resplitting. Validated against the published six-deck Illustrious 18 / Fab 4 (Wizard of Odds).
